top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
Apex Group joins Hedera Council to explore tokenization and settlement
top_signals.summary: Apex Group, overseeing $3.5 trillion in assets, joins the Hedera Council and will explore Hedera for tokenization, compliance and settlement.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Strategy, Metaplanet lose MSCI index membership in November reshuffle
top_signals.summary: Strategy had opposed MSCI’s rules, arguing exclusion would harm its reputation as a neutral provider.
